claims.claim: The first test flight of Galactic Energy's Zhishenxing-1 lifted off at 0200 UTC on September 1 and reportedly placed a dummy payload in orbit.
claims.episode_span: The first test flight of Galactic Energy's Zhishenxing-1 vehicle lifted off at 0200 UTC on September 1. The launch reportedly carried a dummy payload that reached orbit successfully.
claims.source_title: Jonathan McDowell post on Galactic Energy launch
claims.supporting_quote: LAUNCH at 0200 UTC Sep 1 of the first test flight of Xinghe Dongli (Galactic Energy)'s Zhishenxing-1 (Pallas-1) launch vehicle. It reportedly successfully placed a dummy payload in orbit; waiting for US tracking data to confirm.

claims.claim: NASA awarded Blue Origin a firm-fixed-price contract with a maximum value of approximately $700 million for a Mars telecommunications orbiter.
claims.episode_span: Blue Origin received a firm-fixed-price contract with a maximum value of approximately $700 million. The award covers development of a Mars telecommunications orbiter to support future missions.
claims.source_title: NASA Selects Blue Origin as Mars Telecommunications Network Provider
claims.supporting_quote: NASA awarded Blue Origin a contract Tuesday to develop the agency’s Mars Telecommunications Network, a next-generation communications system that will enable reliable, high-bandwidth communications and navigation services for current and future Mars missions.
